name: Bael'dun Keep
summary: Dwarven forces hold Bael'dun Keep above the Bael Modan excavation in the southern Barrens. Under General Twinbraid, this imposing fortification anchors the Alliance's controversial presence in the region and brings it into violent conflict with the surrounding Horde territories.

sections.title: A Dwarven Stronghold in Kalimdor
sections.body: Bael'dun Keep rises over the Bael Modan excavation as the fortified military heart of Ironforge's presence in the southern Barrens. Dwarven architect Haggis Boatmurder designed the stronghold to protect the Prospectors and archaeologists searching the trenches for ancient titan artifacts. Ironworks and artillery arm its garrison, which keeps a vigilant watch, secures dwarven supply lines, and projects Alliance military power into Kalimdor's heartland.

sections.title: A Flashpoint of Bloodshed
sections.body: The keep and its adjoining digsite displaced the local Stonespire tribe of tauren from their ancestral home. Bael'dun remains a flashpoint in the Barrens, and nearby Horde outposts see it as a flagrant military intrusion. Gann Stonespire wages a personal war of vengeance against the invaders. Aggrieved tauren, opportunistic scouts, and suspicious outposts such as Camp Taurajo keep the fortress under threat of raids and sabotage.

faq.answer: Dwarven soldiers garrison Bael'dun Keep under the Alliance and Ironforge's Explorers' League. Their steadfast commander is General Twinbraid.

faq.q: Why is Bael'dun Keep built in the southern Barrens?
aliases: why are dwarves in the barrens
faq.answer: The Alliance established Bael'dun Keep to defend Bael Modan, a massive archaeological expedition seeking titan relics and ancient dwarven origins in Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why are the local tauren attacking Bael'dun Keep?
faq.answer: The excavation and fortress displaced the Stonespire tauren from their ancestral grounds. Survivors such as Gann Stonespire seek vengeance and the destruction of the dwarven invaders.

faq.q: Who was the architect of the fortress?
faq.answer: Dwarven architectural records name Haggis Boatmurder as the architect who designed and constructed the fortress.

angles.text: Bael'dun Keep occupies grounds taken from the Stonespire tribe, a reminder of Alliance encroachment on your homeland.
Bael'dun Keep is your primary military foothold in the southern Barrens, guarding the Explorers' League's vital discoveries against hostile Horde forces.
